title: RLinf/RLinf
abstract:
RLinf: Reinforcement Learning Infrastructure for Embodied and Agentic AI

[ ](README.md) [ ](README.zh-CN.md) RLinf: Reinforcement Learning Infrastructure for Embodied and Agentic AI RLinf is a flexible and scalable open-source RL infrastructure designed for Embodied and Agentic AI. The 'inf' in RLinf stands for `Infrastructure`, highlighting its role as a robust backbone for next-generation training. It also stands for `Infinite`, symbolizing the system’s support for open-ended learning, continuous generalization, and limitless possibilities in intelligence development. ## What's NEW! - [2026/11] 🔥 RLinf supports LIBERO-Mem and MEM-inspired visual short memory for OpenPI SFT and evaluation. Docs: [LIBERO-Mem](https://rlinf.readthedocs.io/en/latest/rst_source/examples/embodied/libero.html#libero-mem-benchmark), [OpenPI Short Memory](https://rlinf.readthedocs.io/en/latest/rst_source/examples/embodied/pi0/short_memory.html). - [2026/11] 🔥 RLinf supports RL on π₀.₅ in [GenieSim](https://github.com/AgibotTech/genie_sim) with PPO and GRPO. Doc: [RL with GenieSim](https://rlinf.readthedocs.io/en/latest/rst_source/examples/embodied/geniesim.html). - [2026/11] 🔥 RLinf supports SO-101 joint-space demonstration collection, OpenPI π₀.₅ supervised fine-tuning, and local evaluation. Doc: [SO-101](https://rlinf.readthedocs.io/en/latest/rst_source/examples/embodied/so101.html). - [2026/11] 🔥 RLinf supports Psi0 VLA and the SIMPLE humanoid simulator. Docs: [Psi0](https://rlinf.readthedocs.io/en/latest/rst_source/examples/embodied/psi0.html), [SIMPLE](https://rlinf.readthedocs.io/en/latest/rst_source/evaluations/guides/simple.html). - [2026/11] 🔥 RLinf supports [PhyAI](https://github.com/mingti-org/phyai) as an in-process rollout backend for π₀.₅ PPO training on LIBERO, including hot weight synchronization. Doc: [PhyAI rollout backend](https://rlinf.readthedocs.io/en/latest/rst_source/guides/rollout-engines/phyai.html). - [2026/10] 🎉 RLinf v0.4 is released, taking RL out of simulation and into agile control of the physical world. abstract_zh: RLinf是一个灵活且可扩展的开源强化学习基础设施，专为具身与智能体AI设计。名称中的“inf”代表“Infrastructure”（基础设施），强调其作为下一代训练稳健后端的角色；同时也代表“Infinite”（无限），象征系统对开放式学习、持续泛化以及智能发展无限可能性的支持。最新进展包括：支持GR00T-N1.7、Polaris模拟器、Genesis等平台的强化学习微调；通过系统级优化（精简、按需观测、混合流水线并行），在BEHAVIOR模拟器上实现了端到端加速，将rollout延迟从1028.7毫秒/步降至41.2毫秒/步。
tldr_zh: RLinf是面向具身与智能体AI的开源强化学习基础设施，支持多种平台并实现显著加速。
cover_zh: 强化学习基础设施新突破｜延迟从1028ms降至41ms
